question: Where was the 4th KIO National (Senior, U-21 & Para) Karate Championship held from 26-29 March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hyderabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 4th KIO National (Senior, U-21 & Para) Karate Championship was held in **Hyderabad**, Telangana, from 26-29 March 2025.
 
• This prestigious event was organized by the **Karate India Organization (KIO)**, which is recognized for promoting karate as a sport across India.
 
• Hyderabad, known for its well-equipped sports facilities, hosted the event to ensure the participation of athletes from diverse regions of India, including para-athletes.
 
• The championship aimed to provide a platform for karate enthusiasts to showcase their skills and foster sportsmanship among participants.
 
• It also served as an opportunity for athletes to qualify for national and international karate competitions in various categories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delhi**

 
 
• Delhi is a prominent hub for national-level sports events due to its state-of-the-art facilities and infrastructure, such as the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium and Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium.
 
• It has hosted events like the 2010 Commonwealth Games and several international and national championships.
 
• However, the 4th KIO National Karate Championship was not conducted in Delhi in 2025.
 
 
 
• **Ahmedabad**
 
 
• Ahmedabad, Gujarat, is known for its newly constructed Narendra Modi Stadium, the world's largest cricket stadium.
 
• It also promotes other sports through various facilities like the Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Sports Complex.
 
 
 
• **Bengaluru**
 
 
• Bengaluru, Karnataka, is known for promoting sports like cricket, hockey, and athletics, with renowned venues like the M. Chinnaswamy Stadium.
 
• The city has hosted several national and international sports events, including badminton and football tournaments.
